mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of building a granny flat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total cost depends on unit square footage, structural style, plumbing placement, and finish selections. New detached builds and ground-up additions require grading, foundation concrete, framing, roofing, and full utility connections, placing them at the higher end of investment. Conversions of existing interior spaces or garages reduce framing expenses but still require electrical panels, plumbing extensions, HVAC, and drywall finishing. Material choices for cabinetry, tile, fixtures, and exterior siding also sway total costs. Bay City Remodeling provides negotiable pricing, detailed project estimates, and veteran discounts to match specific household budgets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Overall costs depend on project size, attached versus detached construction, utility trenching, plumbing needs, drywall finishing, and specific fixture selections.
